title: Stabilize local MVP before next feature expansion
scope: maintenance validation and evidence handoff for stale open issue #2

implementation.reason: The requested route modularization, undo nested relative path handling, route validation helpers, local MVP documentation, and Windows smoke guide were already present in the starting tree.

acceptance.requirement: Legacy in-memory route confusion is removed.
acceptance.evidence: services/api/src/server.js delegates to route modules; no /api/files/ingest route remains in services/api/src/server.js or services/api/src/routes.

services/api/src/routes/files.routes.js, search.routes.js, actions.routes.js, system.routes.js, integrations.routes.js and middleware/auth.js, middleware/errorHandler.js exist and are wired from services/api/src/server.js.
services/api/src/utils/request.js provides request validation helpers used by route modules.
Root npm test passed 182/182; services/api npm test passed 172/172.
